name: A Favour
source:
Set in Umbria, Italy, in 1612, A Favour follows Clarissa, a healer relied upon by her village but regarded with suspicion, after she takes in a wounded stranger named Jaan. 

The visual novel is released in episodic chapters of approximately 45 minutes each.

All artwork is presented as static painted compositions in the style of 17th-century Italian art rather than character sprites.
